'''Cell Block 77-Z''' was part of the [[Lower Halls]] in [[the Tomb]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Part of the [[Belsavis prison]], it was where the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Ekkage]] was incarcerated.
